posts.name: ThatGamer709
posts.cooked: So after looking through all the villain flavor text and cards, I've noticed that all the villains have very decent reasons for the heroes to fight them. Except for Plague Rat. He's one of my favorite villains don't get me wrong, but how did he catch the heroes attention? What has he really done to make them fight him? Plague Rat pretty much sticks to himself in the sewers, eating anyone that might wander to close. That sounds pretty awful but the occasional missing person in a place like Rook City isn't that important. What makes him so important the that Freedom Five have to take time from stopping aliens invade the earth, to stop him from eating the stray hobo?

posts.name: Simsar
posts.cooked:
Just like Spider-man fights the Shocker on a near constant basis (and never seems to lose), Plague Rat is just one of those villains that has the b-movie creature feature quality to him that makes him work. Personally, fighting Plague Rat is kind of a warm up game for me, he's really not that hard with the right heroes in play and if you can wreck his ongoing cards (Nightmist is a good one to use consistently), he's really not much of a threat, just a general annoyance.

Also, to suggest a signature. "You met the boomstick, but have you felt the matchstick?" - ExPatirette before setting fire to the Pike Industries Building
